name: Internship Policy Of Indian Council For Cultural Relations (ICCR)
benefit:
> **Honorarium** An honorarium of ₹ 10,000/- per month will be paid to each intern.
> **Air Fare** The cost of one-time to and fro air travel is subject to a ceiling of the prevailing economy class airfare between the State capital and Delhi, from the domicile State or from the college/ university of the selected candidates will be provided. **NOTE:** The interns would be responsible for
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a citizen of India. 1. The applicant should be a graduate in Humanities/ Mass Communication/ Journalism/ Designing/ Anthropology/ History/ Art/ Archaeology Science/ Languages/ Museology/ Fine Arts. 1. The age of the applicant should be less than or equal to 25 years as of 31st December of the year of the Internship. 1. Post Graduate / Research Students and Foreign Language Students are also eligible. 1. The applicant should have an excellent academic track record. 1. The applicant should preferably be from any recognized University in India.
> **Reservation / Preference / Priority** Research scholars with formal backgrounds in International Relations and Soft Power Projection will be given preference depending upon the requirement of ICCR. The candidates with the highest marks are most likely to be called for Personal Interview.
